service.name: knowledge-observatory
service.description: Real-time monitoring and management of Vrooli's semantic knowledge system - acts as a consciousness monitor for collective intelligence

setup.description: Build API & UI, install CLI, initialize database

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && go mod download && go build -o knowledge-observatory-api .
steps.description: Build Go API binary (knowledge-observatory-api) in api/ directory

steps.name: setup-database
steps.description: Initialize PostgreSQL schema and seed knowledge-observatory data

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && pnpm install --ignore-workspace; else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && pnpm run build; else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and production UI bundle via Node server

steps.name: ensure-ui-build
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ] && [ ! -f ui/dist/index.html ]; then cd ui && pnpm run build; else echo 'UI build already present'; fi
steps.description: Ensure UI bundle exists before Lighthouse audits

steps.name: run-tests
steps.run:
ui_url="http://localhost:${UI_PORT}"
check_health() { curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$ui_url/health" 2>/dev/null || true; }
if curl -sS "$ui_url/" 2>/dev/null | grep -q "Knowledge Observatory UI"; then
  echo "Using existing Knowledge Observatory UI at $ui_url"
  test-genie execute knowledge-observatory --preset comprehensive --ui-url "$ui_url"
  exit $?
fi
if [ "$(check_health)" != "000" ]; then
  echo "Port ${UI_PORT} is already serving a different UI. Stop the conflicting service or free the port."
  exit 1
fi
( cd ui && node server.js ) &
ui_pid=$!
trap 'kill $ui_pid 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 30 ]; do
  if [ "$(check_health)" != "000" ]; then
    break
  fi
  i=$((i+1))
  sleep 1
done
if [ "$(check_health)" = "000" ]; then
  echo "UI failed to start on $ui_url"
  exit 1
fi
test-genie execute knowledge-observatory --preset comprehensive --ui-url "$ui_url"
steps.description: Run structure/unit/integration/business/performance phases (ensures Knowledge Observatory UI is the Lighthouse target)

qdrant.description: Primary vector database containing all semantic knowledge to monitor and search

postgres.description: Knowledge metadata, quality metrics, search history, and configuration storage

ollama.description: Enhanced semantic analysis and natural language query understanding
